en: A black‑and‑white postcard image showing a traditional wooden belfry and an adjacent stone church behind a low stone wall. Leafless and sparsely leaved trees partially obscure the buildings. The architecture is typical of historic Scandinavian rural churches, with a steeply pitched roof and simple arched windows. Printed caption text appears in the upper left, and an additional vertical strip of text is visible along the left margin.
